name: SkillGap-NLP synthetic evaluation set v1
license: CC0 - written by the project authors for this project
provenance: SYNTHETIC. Resume excerpts were written by the project authors to test specific behaviours (paraphrases, related-but-different skills, listed-only skills). They are NOT real resumes and NOT real hiring data.
labelling: Each requirement is labelled demonstrated=true if a careful human reader would accept the excerpt as evidence of the skill. Labels were assigned by the authors; they should be reviewed by a second annotator before results are reported (see docs/evaluation.md).
